mood: Loud, friendly party energy: a cardboard box that explodes with minigames when the lobby opens.

shape.borderStyle: 4px solid #1B0A52 with a 4px hard drop shadow

buttonStyle: Primary is a yellow pill with dark purple Titan One text and a chunky outline that squashes on press; secondary is a pink pill with white text.
backdrop: Purple radial sunburst behind a cardboard box; the rays rotate very slowly (one turn per minute) and confetti drifts down gently.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
